newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel lower against dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel lower against dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel representative rate was fixed lower against the dollar and the basket of key foreign currencies Wednesday in very active trading, dealers said.

"Volume was relatively high today and the business sector converted foreign currency into shekels. The central bank had to intervene again in the market, buying more than $100 million to support the basket," said a dealer at Israel Discount Bank.
The central bank has been intervening regularly in the market to support the currency basket, which has been trading at the bottom end of its trading band since the start of the year.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.4130 shekels, against 3.4070 on Tuesday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6992 against 3.6985 Tuesday.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9339 shekels per 100 yen compared with 2.9413 on Tuesday, and against the mark at 1.9725 shekels compared with 1.9758 on Tuesday.
In the late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.40.. shekels.
